title: PostDiscussionRequest
description: The body of POST /api/v1/discussions/{crew}: a question for the crew.

message.description: The question; must not be blank.

conversationId.description: The conversation to continue. Without it, the gateway starts a new one.

timeZone.description: The person's IANA time zone, such as America/Los_Angeles. Tools that need today's date read it instead of the server's clock. Optional; an unknown zone is ignored.

localDateTime.description: The person's local date and time when they asked, ISO 8601 without an offset, such as 2026-10-24T09:15:00. Optional; an unreadable value is ignored.
